changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'CompanyResourceLog') BEGIN create table [dbo].[CompanyResourceLog]( [ID] bigint identity not null, [CompanyID] int not null, [ResourceID] int not null, [AuthenticationMethod] int not null, [Date] datetime not null, constraint [PK_CompanyResourceLog] primary key clustered ( [ID] asc ) ) END
